title: ShieldCare Late Fee: the Amount Carried by Each Unpaid Period for a Circle Member
content:
The amount carried by each unpaid period on a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan held on
instalments turns on the Northbeam Circle Membership recorded on the profile: on the protection
plan discount the membership tier carries, and on how long that membership has stood active,
counted in whole years from the day it was activated.

| Membership standing on the profile | The fee for each unpaid period |
| --- | --- |
| the tier's protection plan discount is 15 percent or more, and the membership has stood active for at least 3 years | 4.00 |
| that discount is 5 percent or more but under 15 percent, and the membership has stood active for at least 1 year | 8.00 |
| every other profile | the plan's late fee |

### Both sides of each threshold

A membership tier carrying a protection plan discount of exactly 15 percent is inside the first
band; a tier carrying 14 percent is not, and falls to be tested against the second. A membership
active for exactly 3 whole years is inside the first band; one active for 2 whole years and eleven
months is not. In the second band a discount of exactly 5 percent is inside it and a discount of
exactly 15 percent is above it, so the second band is the range from 5 percent up to but not
including 15 percent; a membership active for exactly 1 whole year is inside that band.

### The combinations set out

| Tier's protection plan discount | Whole years the membership has stood active | The fee for each unpaid period |
| --- | --- | --- |
| no discount, or no active membership on the profile | any | the plan's late fee |
| 9 percent | 0 | the plan's late fee |
| 18 percent | 2 | the plan's late fee |
| 9 percent | 3 | 8.00 |
| 18 percent | 4 | 4.00 |

Both conditions of a band must hold together: a rich discount on a membership only lately
activated does not reach the first band, and a long-standing membership on a tier carrying no plan
discount reaches neither.
